title: Universal collision bound
statement: Let $S$, $\alpha$, and $\beta$ be finite types, and let $f:S\to\alpha\to\beta$. The map $f$ is universal if, for every pair of distinct elements $x,y\in\alpha$, the number of $s\in S$ for which $f(s,x)=f(s,y)$ is at most $|S|/|\beta|$.
hypotheses_covered: The bound is required for every distinct $x,y\in\alpha$
